name: Bimetallic-Chronometer Hub
core_rationale: Central thermal-chronometer sanctuary town of Bimetallic Escapement Mesa at [1, 1] where horologist guilds calibrate copper-and-invar compensation pendulums above the Invar Balance Vault.

terrain_tile.water_feature: Mirror-polished invar cooling basins stabilizing the central bimetallic chronometer spire

North.lock_message: Concentrated solar-noon thermal expansion across Solar-Coil Overlook warps uncalibrated gear; Chronometer-Master Vane requires the Zero-Expansion Invar Key before opening the northern heliostat gate.

resident_npcs.name: Chronometer-Master Vane
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Welcome to Bimetallic-Chronometer Hub! Step up to my 0.58 meter invar calibration bench—our twin-metal pendulums never lose a second in the desert sun.

resident_npcs.name: Invar-Smith Talia
resident_npcs.dialogue_greeting: Deep inside the Invar Balance Vault, an over-wound balance colossus guards the Zero-Expansion Invar Key needed for Solar-Coil Overlook!

causal_continuity.evidence: Anchors Bimetallic Escapement Mesa at [1, 1] directly above Krono's Invar Balance Vault and connects west to Bimetallic Expansion Span.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Copper-and-invar chronometer sanctuary crowned by sun-tracking compensation pendulums.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: 0.58 to 0.60m horology benches, 0.14m invar risers, 2.20m x 1.65m doorways, and 13.0m plazas for 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Safe town hub (0 resident_spawns) at [1, 1] with symmetric West, Dungeon, and North (fog_of_lore) portals.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Guards the northern Solar-Coil Overlook behind a Fog of Lore portal with explicit lock_message.
